purpose: Necessary obstruction to a new posterior-only weak stopping lemma; not a G_c input or kernel counterexample
arithmetic: Pure fractions.Fraction, integer binomial coefficients; no floats in predicates
baseline: Disjoint finite boxes E_k, volume binom(n,k)*b_k/lambda, amplitude a_k=lambda/b_k; b_k=(k/n)^k*(1-k/n)^(n-k), 0^0=1
height_cap_version: H=lambda*max(1,max_{k>=1}1/[binom(n,k)*b_k]); replace E0 volume by 1/H and a0 by H, keeping k>=1
checks: Each integral a_k equals binom(n,k), initial source mass one
For selected r total response mass one in both versions
Basis derivative identity, zero derivative at each interior peak and signed nearby derivatives
Peak heights lambda or H, algebraic posterior mean k=n*p_k and variance zero
Strict > superlevel integral at every registered threshold, monotone exact approach to weak supremum
Exact strict endpoint sets at lambda and H
Enhanced global weak supremum D_n-1+lambda/H exceeds one
All boxes finite and disjoint via one-axis separated placement
excluded: No original G_c convolution, no reset proxy, no previous numerical rerun
No claim that real mask coefficients can be assigned independently
